key_provisions_or_claims: National ministers act on behalf of Fukushima Prefecture for reconstruction works on ports, roads, rivers, coasts and landslide prevention.
Cost-sharing rules between the state and Fukushima Prefecture or local governments for reconstruction works.
Trademark, plant variety and registration fee reductions for certified Fukushima reconstruction plans.
Article 43 allows reduced-price use of national test and research facilities for projects developing new robot products or technologies, certified by the Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry.
Rules on seconded staff pensions and on land-lease requirements in evacuation-designated areas.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese Cabinet Order implementing the Fukushima Reconstruction and Revitalization Special Measures Act. It sets rules on national proxy execution of reconstruction works, cost sharing, fee reductions, and land and staff matters. Article 43 provides discounted use of national research facilities for robot technology development projects.
annotation.title_clean: 福島復興再生特別措置法施行令
annotation.title_en: Order for Enforcement of the Act on Special Measures for the Reconstruction and Revitalization of Fukushima
